personal_info.name: Roma Kay
personal_info.current_headline: Vice President - Global Sales Operations at Wesco | Senior Sales and Customer Service Professional
personal_info.summary: During my tenure as Vice President of Global Sales Operations, I have spearheaded numerous initiatives that drive both business growth and operational excellence. Our success is anchored in a strategic approach to account management and solution selling, key competencies that I have honed and developed through my extensive experience in sales leadership. My role encompasses the overseeing and management of global and complex projects, covering all aspects of compliance, tax, and optimal ways to support the overall deployment of global projects. This involves ensuring that our operations adhere to regulatory requirements while maximizing efficiency and effectiveness. Post-merger with Anixter, my focus has been on integrating a comprehensive product and services portfolio, while fostering cross-functional relationships. This collaborative effort has not only expanded our market presence but also reinforced Wesco's standing as a Fortune 500 entity, showcasing a commitment to innovation and customer-centric solutions.

experience.title: VP Global Sales Operations
experience.description: Wesco International builds, connects, powers and protects the world. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Wesco is a FORTUNE 500® company with more than $22 billion in annual sales and a leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions. Wesco offers a best-in-class product and services portfolio of Electrical and Electronic Solutions, Communications and Security Solutions, and Utility and Broadband Solutions. The Company employs approximately 20,000 people, partners with the industry's premier suppliers, and serves thousands of customers around the world. With millions of products, end-to-end supply chain services, and leading digital capabilities, Wesco provides innovative solutions to meet customer needs across commercial and industrial businesses, contractors, government agencies, educational institutions, telecommunications providers, and utilities.

experience.title: Vice President - Global Sales Operations
experience.description: In 2020, Wesco acquired Anixter International Inc., a leading global distributor of network & security solutions, electrical & electronic solutions, and utility power solutions. The merger resulted in a combined company with a comprehensive and balanced portfolio that united Wesco's capabilities in industrial, construction, and utility with Anixter’s expertise in data communications, security, and wire and cable.

Responsible for maintaining and updating the group’s home page on Anixter’s internal website, including pricing information, vendor information, important notices.

Supported IBM on various cabling and security projects.
